config.lyrics_provider_notice.title: Lyrics sources
config.lyrics_provider_notice.content:
### Lyrics sources

- **Third party**: Fetches lyrics through [PaxSenix Apple Music Lyrics](https://lyrics.paxsenix.org/apple-music/lyrics). No Apple Music login is required.
- **Official**: Fetches lyrics from Apple Music. Enter the `media-user-token` from your web login cookies.

Official source limitations:

- The region of your `media-user-token` must match the selected region below.
- Tokens expire and must be renewed when invalid.
- Frequent requests or batch matching may trigger rate limits or temporary blocks.
- Official lyrics are only available for songs accessible to your account and region.
